finding.issue: The policy-v4 production candidate built and keyed one immutable hydraulic representation from initialized cofgen(:,1), then applied that representation to every active node. Existing qualification matrices varied material between homogeneous profiles and therefore did not qualify layered or heterogeneous within-profile hydraulics.

repair.policy: AHL remains admitted only when all active nodes have bit-identical initialized 42-coefficient hydraulic authority. Heterogeneous/layered profiles fall back fully to the authoritative analytical provider.
repair.provider_api: Direct adaptive-provider binding fails closed for heterogeneous profiles.
repair.runtime: Profile homogeneity is evaluated once during parameter configuration and cached as a boolean; no O(nodes) authority scan is added to the solve hot path.
repair.lifecycle: Unsupported adaptive provider state is released; shared immutable cache remains unaffected.
repair.regression: Candidate CI now requires an O0/O2 heterogeneous-profile fallback test with bit-identical analytical state/flux behavior and zero AHL cache activity.

dry_domain_note.meaning: representation-work relevance bound, not a physical theta or K cutoff

nonclaims: Layered AHL is not qualified or admitted.
Older green candidate runs do not qualify the repaired head.
